note: Packs the user owns. Agents may import them with Unity's importer, audit and look at them, set up their materials in Unity and arrange their prefabs. Agents never make or edit 3D models from them, never upload them to AI 3D or image tools, and never commit them (AGENTS.md rule 3, PLAN 4.7). The packs import themselves into Game/Assets/Synty/, which is gitignored. PolygonGeneric and SyntyPackageHelper are shared by all three packs.

reimport: Unity.exe -batchmode -nographics -quit -projectPath Game -importPackage <localFile>, once per pack, then SyntyTools.Convert and SyntyTools.Audit. Re-importing keeps the same GUIDs, so scene references survive.
